items.title: The cooling curve is described twice, in two ways
items.body: The handbook says the kiln cools freely, and the controller sheet lists a three-stage controlled cool. Both are in use.
items.fix: Pick the controlled cool and delete the free-cool paragraph.

items.title: Two documents give different top temperatures for the same glaze
items.body: The glaze card says cone 6 (1222 °C). The firing schedule peaks at 1260 °C, which is cone 8. A load fired to the schedule overfires the glaze.
evidence: cone pack from the last firing
items.fix: Cap ramp 4 at 1222 °C and re-fire one test tile.

items.title: No one is named for the weekend cool-down
items.body: A firing started on Friday evening finishes cooling on Sunday morning. The rota ends on Friday at 17:00.
items.fix: Add a Sunday 09:00 unload slot with a named person.

items.title: The log template has two columns that nobody fills in
items.body: Humidity and kiln-room temperature have been blank for six months.

items.title: The vent interlock works
items.body: The controller refused to start with the fan off, three times out of three.
